definitions.explanation: A refined, sophisticated aesthetic sensibility associated with the aristocratic culture of the Heian period; the quality of being tasteful and cultured.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{雅|みやび} was the aesthetic ideal of the Heian aristocracy (794–1185): refined taste, accomplishment in poetry, music, and calligraphy, and elegant manners.

ETYMOLOGY:
- From the old verb みやぶ, "to behave in the manner of the {宮|みや} (court)".

FORMS:
- {雅|みやび}な + noun: refined, elegant
- {雅|みやび}やか: elegant (adjectival form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{王朝|おうちょう}→王朝：13516_ouchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{雅|みやび}: courtly elegance
- {雅|みやび}な⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: a refined world

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{侘|わ}び→侘び：10655_wabi⟧: rustic simplicity
- {寂|さ}び: the beauty of age and patina
- ⟦{粋|いき}→粋：13773_iki⟧: the urban chic of Edo townspeople
